counterexample_attempts: Recomputed the campaign-canonical SHA-256 as SHA-256 of json.dumps(parsed JSON, sort_keys=True); it exactly matches the supplied immutable digest. The raw-file digest differs only because of formatting.
Checked the off-by-one thresholds: avoiding wt<=R and wt>=n-R gives exactly D<=wt<=n-D, where R=D-1.
Tested the binomial-tail certificate at every tight rational inequality, including the logarithm remainder, exponential Taylor bound, and final margin 1083-1900544/1755=121/1755.
Tested the endpoint-ratio product bound where its right-hand side changes sign and after extending t_j=0 beyond j=R; no invalid positive lower bound occurs.
Checked the parity-coset moment calculation separately for even and odd numbers of complemented circuit words; the omitted sign is harmless because both cases are bounded by cosh(t)^s+sinh(t)^s.
Checked the small-circuit boundary sizes s=3, 253, and 255 and the handoff to s=257; there is no omitted odd size.
Tested the Fourier-convolution identity for negative nontrivial coefficients. Replacing each odd power by its absolute-value bound remains a valid upper bound.

Tried an odd zero-sum subset that is not initially a circuit. Taking a minimum-cardinality odd zero-sum subset, or extracting and deleting a contained zero-sum relation, produces the required odd circuit.
Tested the B(G_*)=empty edge case. The separately prescribed functional ell(u)=u_1 is nonzero and still gives a 2970-dimensional kernel.
Tried to create a kernel word uG_*=0 for nonzero u in U; this would put u in the lower bad tail and contradict U intersect B(G_*)=empty.
Tried to place the all-one vector J in UG_*; every nonzero word there has weight at most n-D<n, so this is impossible.
Tested the extremal safe weights D and n-D. Their complements also have weights n-D and D respectively, so neither creates a low-weight final codeword.
Recomputed the claimed K=2972 method obstruction: its doubled lambda bound is below 2166, but 2^-2972 exp(2166)>1, so the stated limitation of that estimator is accurate.

line_audit.justification: N=536870912, h=1048577, R=N-h=535822335, and D=R+1=N-2^20=535822336. The vector J has exactly n coordinates.

line_audit.claim: The potential includes every circuit size needed for expurgation.
line_audit.justification: Psi<1 implies |B|<=1083. Any circuit contained in B then has size at most 1083, while nonzero distinct binary vectors admit no circuit of size 1 or 2; hence odd sizes 3 through 1083 suffice.

line_audit.claim: The matrix G_* is deterministic and symbolically recoverable.
line_audit.justification: The row-major order, exact conditional averages, smaller-child rule, and tie choice are fixed. Psi takes rational values, so every comparison is a finite exact computation; no random choice remains.

line_audit.claim: The functional, kernel basis, and final code contain no unspecified finite choice.
line_audit.justification: A coefficient-vector lexicographic minimum fixes ell when B is nonempty; the empty-set case fixes ell(u)=u_1. The first pivot and displayed ordered basis then determine U and C.

line_audit.claim: Absence of odd circuits implies a hyperplane avoiding B.
line_audit.justification: The system ell(b)=1 is inconsistent exactly when an odd subset of B sums to zero. A minimum-cardinality such subset is an odd circuit, contradicting the constructed circuit counts.

line_audit.claim: The discussion of the K=2972 limitation is numerically honest.
line_audit.justification: Increasing K by one doubles lambda to below 2166, while 2166>2972 log 2, so the displayed zero-frequency exponential upper bound exceeds one. The text correctly limits this obstruction to the present estimator.

line_audit.claim: The distance and explicitness audit lists accurately summarize the construction.
line_audit.justification: Avoidance of B proves both-sided weight control, injectivity, exclusion of J, and complement safety. Every construction choice is fixed and the matrix has exactly n columns without padding or puncturing.

line_audit.claim: The parameter ledger arithmetic is correct.
line_audit.justification: The recomputed values are n=1073741824, N=536870912, h=1048577, R=535822335, D=535822336, lambda<1900544/1755<1083, balanced-subcode dimension 2970, and final dimension 2971.

line_audit.claim: The exact rate and bias ledger entries are correct.
line_audit.justification: Because 2971 is odd, 2971/2^30 is reduced and equals 0.000002766959369182586669921875. The interval [D,n-D]/n=[511/1024,513/1024] gives normalized absolute bias at most 1/512.

line_audit.claim: The exact binomial-tail certificate proves 2^2972 p<1083.
line_audit.justification: The geometric tail factor, central-binomial induction, shifted-coefficient product, and rational logarithm/exponential estimates all check. In particular E>2048 and the final bound is 1900544/1755=1082.931054... .

line_audit.claim: The Fourier endpoint estimate gives every nontrivial coefficient magnitude below q/256.
line_audit.justification: Coordinate pairing leaves only the radius-R sphere and gives |fhat(S)|<=2^-n binom(n-1,R). The exact lower bound p/p_R=18921810959967451087/73787292954639991 exceeds 256, and translation by J supplies the required factor for g.

line_audit.claim: The expected bad-set bound is correct.
line_audit.justification: For each nonzero u, uG is uniform, the two tails are disjoint, and q=2p. Thus E|B|=(2^K-1)q<2^2972p<1083.

line_audit.claim: The small odd-circuit expectation is below 2^-27.
line_audit.justification: A circuit's column values are uniform on a parity coset. The orientation moment bound, the s! circuit representation count, monotonicity through s=255, 255!>=2^1504, and exp(-522231)<2^-753419 jointly give the stated sum.

line_audit.claim: The large odd-circuit expectation is below 2^-742.
line_audit.justification: Fourier convolution gives sum_S ghat(S)^s with no missing normalization. Parseval and the nontrivial coefficient bound yield q^s+(q/256)^(s-2)q; the exponential and factorial estimates for all s>=257 recompute correctly.

line_audit.claim: Conditional averaging produces Psi(G_*)<1.
line_audit.justification: Each prefix average is the arithmetic mean of its two child averages, so the prescribed child never increases it. The initial estimate 1083/1084+2^-26 is strictly below one.

line_audit.claim: Psi(G_*)<1 gives both the bad-set bound and vanishing circuit counts.
line_audit.justification: Every T_s is a nonnegative integer, so any positive circuit count would make Psi at least one. Also |B|/1084<1 implies the integer bound |B|<=1083.

line_audit.claim: The odd-circuit expurgation gives dim U=2970 and U intersect B=empty.
line_audit.justification: The consistency criterion for ell(b)=1 is the absence of odd zero-sum subsets. The selected ell is nonzero, including when B is empty, so its kernel has codimension one and cannot contain a bad message.

line_audit.claim: The final encoder is injective and has dimension 2971.
line_audit.justification: A nonzero u in U cannot map to zero because it would be bad. Every nonzero image word has weight at most n-D<n, excluding J from UG_*. Therefore C=UG_* direct-sum span{J} has dimension 2970+1.

line_audit.claim: Every nonzero final codeword has weight at least D.
line_audit.justification: The exhaustive cases are J, uG_* for nonzero u, and J+uG_*. Their respective weights are n, at least D, and n-wt(uG_*)>=D.

line_audit.claim: The proof-step dependency graph accurately summarizes the full proof.
line_audit.justification: The tail certificate feeds the small-circuit and Fourier bounds, those feed conditional averaging, and expurgation then supplies the final parameters. No proof step assumes the desired code in advance.

line_audit.claim: The status, provenance, classification, theorem statement, and title are consistent with the audited result.
line_audit.justification: The listed source paths exist and conceal no mathematical dependency. The submission appropriately remains a candidate pending this review, while its theorem and title state the verified lower-bound parameters without claiming an exact unknown distance.

summary: ACCEPT. The submission gives a deterministic, symbolically recoverable binary linear code of exact length 1073741824, dimension 2971, and certified minimum distance at least 535822336. The binomial-tail, small- and large-circuit, conditional-averaging, odd-circuit expurgation, dimension, rate, and distance arguments all pass independent recomputation. The recursion is computationally prohibitive, but the stated target imposes no efficiency or local-explicitness requirement.
